The problem & the fix

Most signal groups leave you guessing.

A price and an arrow isn’t a trade plan. Here’s what usually goes wrong — and how this group runs instead.

Problem

No reasoning

You get an entry but no idea why. When the market turns, you don’t know what to do with it.

Problem

Only the wins get shown

Screenshots of green trades, silence on the red ones. You can’t judge what you can’t see.

Problem

Nobody to ask

Thousands of members, no answers. You stay a follower instead of learning to read the chart.

How Ezat runs it

One trader. Live calls. The thinking with it.

  • Ideas posted as they happenSetups go into the group while they’re still live, not afterwards.
  • Every call is explainedWhy the level matters, where the risk sits, what invalidates it.
  • Questions get answeredAsk in the group — that’s the point of having 68,000 people in one room.
